title: share.reversed payload v1
description: The part of a payment's revenue share that a refund takes back. The share left after the charge's total refunded so far is share - round(share x refunded_total / collected), from the running total so that rounding never drifts and a full refund leaves 0.

payment_id.description: The id of the payment.succeeded whose share this reverses (as in share.accrued).

refunded_total.description: The charge's total refunded so far (cents), after this refund.

share_before.description: The share standing before this reversal: accrued less what was reversed already (cents).

share_after.description: The share standing after this reversal (cents).

reversed.description: What this event takes back: share_before less share_after (cents), at least 1.
